'''Eidolon's safe house''' was a safe house on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] owned by an assassin known as [[Eidolon (assassin)|the Eidolon]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:PC" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]], a [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] confronted the Eidolon, who was a target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], in his safe house and defeated him after a battle.<ref name="TOR:PC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eidolon's safe house appear as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission.<ref name="TOR:PC" />
